FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Pinnacle Realty Group is a licensed real estate agency specializing in residential property transactions, focused on serving the Springfield community. Our operations involve facilitating property sales between buyers and sellers, providing expert market insight, and assisting clients throughout the entire transaction process to ensure smooth and successful outcomes. We maintain strict compliance with all applicable real estate laws and regulations and have implemented robust risk management strategies to mitigate potential liabilities. Our team is composed of experienced, licensed real estate agents committed to delivering exceptional service and maintaining high ethical standards. We also establish strong partnerships with reputable vendors, including title companies and mortgage lenders, to enhance our service offerings and client experience. Our agency values transparency and thorough documentation, ensuring all transactions are well-managed and compliant, thus minimizing any risks associated with misrepresentation or errors.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any property development, construction management, or active property management activities and confirms that we strictly operate within the real estate sector. We consistently maintain current licensing and adhere to all applicable real estate laws and regulations. Additionally, we have disclosed all prior losses, claims, and regulatory actions related to property transactions, ensuring full transparency in our operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a minor slip and fall incident occurred at one of the properties during an open house event. The client filed a claim for medical expenses, resulting in a total loss amount of $1,250. The claim was resolved amicably, and the status is closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: The safe is a Class A vault, Grade 1, labeled as "High Security".
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Steel fencing with a monitored security system and regular patrols.
